summary: Generate and edit images and videos with Grok Imagine through RunAPI. Use when the user asks an agent to create, edit, animate, or transform media with Grok Imagine. Default to the RunAPI CLI for one-off generation; use SDKs only when the user is integrating RunAPI into an app or backend.
